info.description:
UniVec embedding interoperability API. Translate embeddings between model spaces without rebuilding a vector index, generate embeddings with open-source models, and bridge text into a target model space.

Unofficial definition authored by Voxgig from UniVec's public web application and verified against the live public API. Not an official UniVec document.
